exposure: eccentric pregnancy implantation within the endometrial cavity
concentric pregnancy implantation within the endometrial cavity
outcome: migration of pregnancy to centric location
cohort: The study included 8 women with first-trimester eccentric pregnancy implantation (study group) and 10 women with first-trimester concentric pregnancy implantation (control group).
finding: Patients with eccentric pregnancy implantation had a significantly higher incidence of uterine anomalies (50.0% vs. 8.8%), and all early pregnancy demises occurred in cases where the pregnancy persisted eccentrically and involved uterine malformations.
